Answers & Clarity

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our products, techniques, and appointment policies.

How long does a detailing appointment take?

Our Express Refresh takes approximately 30 to 45 minutes. The Signature Detail takes 90 to 120 minutes, while multi-stage paint correction and ceramic coatings typically require 3.5 to 5 hours depending on paint condition and cure requirements.

What makes Ceramic Coating superior to standard wax?

Traditional carnauba wax washes off within 4 to 8 weeks in rain and heat. Ceramic coating forms a semi-permanent inorganic covalent bond (9H hardness) with your clear coat that resists acid rain, bird droppings, road salt, and UV oxidation for 3 to 5+ years.

Do I need to book in advance, or do you take drive-ins?

We welcome drive-in arrivals for our Express Hand Wash whenever bays are available. For Full Interior Detailing, Paint Correction, and Ceramic Coatings, we strongly suggest booking in advance through our online form or phone to reserve your dedicated technician.

Do you use scratch-safe wash techniques?

Always. We follow the two-bucket wash method with grit guards, ultra-plush Korean microfiber wash mitts, pH-neutral lubricating snow foams, and warm filtered de-ionized water that leaves zero water spots.

What if it rains on the day of my appointment?

All detailing and ceramic curing processes are performed indoors within our climate-controlled, dust-free LED detailing bays. If the weather is inclement on pickup, we gladly hold your vehicle in our secure indoor showroom until the weather clears.
